cases.caption: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side.
cases.action: twisting (wringing) something wet until water comes out
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A large, wet canvas is twisted to remove excess paint, leaving drips down the side. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Ensure the canvas is sufficiently wet to allow for smooth twisting without tearing.
Position the canvas vertically to facilitate gravity-assisted drips during the twisting motion.
Apply consistent pressure to twist the canvas evenly along its length to remove paint.
Allow the drips to fall freely without obstruction to achieve desired paint distribution.

cases.caption: A tightly folded parachute is unfolded, revealing its vibrant colors and intricate design.
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A tightly folded parachute is unfolded, revealing its vibrant colors and intricate design. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The parachute must be initially in a tightly folded state before unfolding.
The unfolding process must reveal the parachute's vibrant color gradient and radial pattern.
The parachute must transition from a compact form to a fully deployed, open canopy.
The deployment must occur without external assistance, relying solely on the parachute's internal mechanisms.

evaluation.average_definition: mean of (SA + PC) / 2; custom summary, not official Joint Score
evaluation.missing_policy: no final comparison unless every selected case has both valid SA and PC scores

scope: Four-case diagnostic subset of shared-first-image VideoPhy2 I2V; not a benchmark-wide score
input_scope: First image, caption and original first/caption requirements only
paired_control: Same checkpoint including trained Wan LoRA; only C strength changes in both CFG arms
selection: Fixed before this ablation: jump, wet-canvas twisting, elastic-cord stretching, parachute unfolding
